title: Diagnostic Review: Churn Metric Formulation and Imputation Leakage
description: Inspect a cohort retention analytics pipeline for selection bias, improper global imputation, and unweighted summary metric formulation.

artifact.content:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def compute_monthly_churn(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, float]:
    # Filter active verified accounts
    filtered_df = df[df["email_verified"] == True].copy()

    # Impute missing customer lifetime spend
    imputed_spend = df["total_spend_inr"].fillna(df["total_spend_inr"].mean())
    filtered_df["imputed_spend"] = imputed_spend

    # Compute monthly churn rates
    monthly_rates = []
    for month in filtered_df["signup_month"].unique():
        cohort = filtered_df[filtered_df["signup_month"] == month]
        churned = cohort[cohort["status"] == "CHURNED"]
        rate = len(churned) / len(cohort) if len(cohort) > 0 else 0.0
        monthly_rates.append(rate)

    # Calculate overall platform churn metric
    platform_churn = float(np.mean(monthly_rates))

    return {
        "platform_churn": round(platform_churn, 4),
        "total_cohorts": len(monthly_rates),
    }

defects.title: Selection Bias from Pre-Filtering Unverified Accounts
defects.consequence: Filtering out unverified signups prior to cohort formation artificially inflates measured retention and introduces severe survivor bias.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Retain all registered accounts in the cohort denominator, or evaluate verified and unverified cohorts as stratified segments.

defects.title: Global Mean Imputation Across Stratified Segments
defects.consequence: Imputing missing values using the global unstratified mean distorts segment variance and leaks cohort-level properties into individual records.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Impute missing spend within specific signup cohorts or use median imputation with an explicit missingness indicator flag.

defects.title: Unweighted Arithmetic Mean of Cohort Churn Rates
defects.consequence: Taking a simple unweighted arithmetic mean over monthly churn rates treats large and small cohorts identically, violating volume weighting.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Calculate platform churn by dividing total churned users across all cohorts by total cohort users, or use volume-weighted averages.
